name: Clear explanation
definition: Explicitly values clear explanations; exclude generic praise without a clarity statement.

name: Understanding 988
definition: Learning what 988 is, when to use it, or how it works.

name: Request for interactive scenarios
definition: Explicit request for scenarios, practice calls, roleplay, or hands-on exercises; exclude praise for exercises already included.

name: Pacing or duration
definition: Requested adjustment to speed, time allocation, or duration; review direction manually.

name: Accessibility or language
definition: Requested language, captioning, readability, or other access adjustments.

name: No suggested change
definition: Explicitly states no changes are needed. Not equivalent to missing or unclear text.

name: Unclear response
definition: Nonblank response whose meaning cannot be reliably coded. Assign manually; never infer from a lack of keyword matches.

name: Other reviewed content
definition: Meaningful reviewed content not covered by this initial codebook. Document and refine the codebook if recurring.
